operations.command:
set -ex
P=$(blkid -t TYPE=crypto_LUKS -o device | head -1)
test -n "$P"
printf %s "$P" > /var/tmp/e2e-luks
slots=$(systemd-cryptenroll "$P")
if printf '%s\n' "$slots" | grep -qw tpm2; then exit 1; fi
printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$P"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id > /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-boot
printf passphrase-boot-without-tpm2

set -ex
n=$(grep -ac 'Please enter passphrase' '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/serial.log')
test "$n" -ge 1
printf %s "$n" > '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/prompts-before'
printf prompts-counted

set -ex
P=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-luks)
if ! PASSWORD=testpass123 nixosctl tpm2 enable > /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-enable.log 2>&1; then cat /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-enable.log; exit 1; fi
systemd-cryptenroll "$P" | grep -w tpm2
cryptsetup luksDump "$P" | grep -F systemd-tpm2
sync
printf tpm2-enrolled

set -ex
P=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-luks)
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" != "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-boot)"
cryptsetup status root | grep -F 'is active'
findmnt -rn -o SOURCE / | grep -F /dev/mapper/root
systemd-cryptenroll "$P" | grep -w tpm2
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id > /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-boot
printf booted-without-a-passphrase

set -ex
n=$(grep -ac 'Please enter passphrase' '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/serial.log' || true)
test "$n" = "$(cat '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/prompts-before')"
printf no-prompt-on-the-tpm2-boot

set -ex
P=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-luks)
if ! nixosctl tpm2 disable > /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-disable.log 2>&1; then cat /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-disable.log; exit 1; fi
slots=$(systemd-cryptenroll "$P")
if printf '%s\n' "$slots" | grep -qw tpm2; then exit 1; fi
printf %s testpass123 | cryptsetup open --test-passphrase "$P"
sync
printf tpm2-wiped

set -ex
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" != "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-tpm2-boot)"
cryptsetup status root | grep -F 'is active'
slots=$(systemd-cryptenroll "$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-luks)")
if printf '%s\n' "$slots" | grep -qw tpm2; then exit 1; fi
printf passphrase-needed-again
